requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-4556--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

372-6767-8095.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

2583-4636-6291.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Stridehangar Automaton.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

670-1619-6144-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6144-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Goliath Paladin to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

3259-5223-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4217-6747-7302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4217-6747-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.

243-413-628.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Plague Belcher enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

5231-6754-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

527-725-7093.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has power 5 or greater.
527-725-7093.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nontoken colored legendary creature.
You have a colored legendary creature card in hand.
527-725-7093.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping another nontoken colored legendary creature you control, untapping Selvala.
Cast a legendary creature from your hand for its web-slinging cost by paying {G}{W}{U} and returning the creature tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

893-2438-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

777-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4222-4289-6936.description:
Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

6676-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
6676-6922.notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
6676-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Demonic Pact and causing you to draw a card.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

3617-4423-4482-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
3617-4423-4482-6886.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

3641-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3476-4056-4679--82.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Second Wind attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Second Wind token's second ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Phantatog by sacrificing the Second Wind token.
Repeat.
3476-4056-4679--82.notes: If the creature being tapped for mana can add {3} or more, this combo will net infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

3490-5231-6665.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}.
When the creature leaves the battlefield, Judge Magister triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2468-4499-6587-6588.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

2084-6198.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-6198.description:
Cast Self-Reflection by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

510-2281-3967.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-4050.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding one mana of any color.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1251-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2816-4763-5553-6068.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, targeting Koll.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-2438-2510-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2438-2510-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

11-2631-5257.description:
Cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Alrund's Epiphany.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Alrund's Epiphany, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Alrund's Epiphany and returning the original Alrund's Epiphany to your hand.
Resolve Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-2631-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

2736-4691-5919.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

1267-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
"Assassin" chosen with Rukarumel.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Maskwood Nexus, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Medomai the Ageless token.
The Medomai the Ageless token triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Medomai the Ageless token.
During the combat phase of your extra turn, declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1477-2440-3490.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1477-2440-3490.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
1477-2440-3490.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

215-3924-4050-4115.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Elf or Druid, or have an Elf or Druid card in your graveyard.
215-3924-4050-4115.description:
Cast Deep Forest Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Volo triggers, copying the Deep Forest Hermit spell.
Resolve the copy of the Deep Forest Hermit spell.
When the token Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the original Deep Forest Hermit spell.
When the nontoken Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing the Deep Forest Hermit token and six Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deep Forest Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

49-1799-2034-4242.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
49-1799-2034-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

152-851-1872.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate both Composite Golem tokens by sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-3129-3867-4231-5032.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your graveyard by paying {G}, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

215-866-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green plus the number of times you've cast your commander from the command zone this game is equal to or greater than seven.
215-866-3291.description:
Cast Karametra's Acolyte for its blitz cost by paying at most {3}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with haste.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
